references.context: Topology: closed continuous map sending closed subsets of domain to closed subsets of codomain

references.disposition: The quantifier runs over all Z, not just discrete, compact, or base-change-over-Y spaces.

review_rationale: Inspected the external-product test for Bourbaki properness: id_Z×f must be closed for every auxiliary topological space Z. This differs in setup from the relative-base-change definition of universally closed maps.
